== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Blaster Rifle (Dark) (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Blaster Rifle (Dark)]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-premiere-wb-ds-blaster-rifle/ SWCCGcards], [https://swccgcards.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/jpn_premiere_wb_ds_Blaster_Rifle.png source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(8, 6, 843, 1194)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>98ebc715f112a250b22e6b3e8aff56aacfb77bff9436d6e326bbe390df6a7079</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
